__comment: Profession definitions for all dwarf roles.
PROFESSION SYSTEM:
Every dwarf has exactly one active profession at a time.
All dwarves start as Worker (base profession, cannot be removed).
A dwarf can be promoted to any other profession via the labour UI.
Switching professions does not reset experience — accumulated task counts
are retained per profession key so a dwarf who returns to a prior role
resumes from where they left off.
EXPERIENCE:
Experience is tracked as a raw task count per profession key.
Experience level (1–5, or 6 with a qualifying trait) is derived at runtime
by comparing the task count against the global thresholds defined in
'experience_thresholds' below.
Level 6 requires both the task count threshold AND a specific trait
(trait system not yet designed — flag reserved).
WORK SPEED BONUS:
work_speed_bonus_per_level applies to the dwarf's primary task types only.
Formula: task_duration × (1.0 - (experience_level - 1) × work_speed_bonus_per_level)
At level 5 with bonus 0.05: task_duration × 0.80 (20% faster).
At level 6 with bonus 0.05: task_duration × 0.75 (25% faster).
REQUIRED_SKILL IN RECIPE FILES:
The 'required_skill' field in brewery.json and aging_cellar.json maps directly
to the Brewer's experience level. A Brewer at experience level N can perform
any recipe with required_skill ≤ N. The field name is kept as 'required_skill'
in recipe files for brevity; it is synonymous with 'required_experience_level'.
Other professions with gated tasks will follow the same convention.
FALLBACK BEHAVIOUR:
When a specialised dwarf has no primary tasks queued, they fall back to
Worker tasks (hauling, clearing rubble). This prevents idle specialists.
Fallback task quality and speed are unaffected by profession experience.
STATUS FIELD:
'active'          — fully designed and implemented.
'not_implemented' — namespace reserved; design stub only.
No tasks or rooms reference this profession yet.
Universal thresholds shared by all professions.
Values are cumulative task counts completed under the given profession.
Level is derived at runtime — store only the raw task count in save data.

base:profession:worker.description: The foundation of every dwarven colony. Workers haul goods, clear rubble, and fill in wherever a specialist is unavailable. Every dwarf begins as a Worker and retains this as a fallback when reassigned.

experience_levels.description: Can haul any item and clear rubble. The backbone of the colony before specialists are trained.
Moves between stockpiles and workshops 5% faster. Noticeably more efficient on long haul routes.
10% faster. Experienced enough to optimise multi-stop haul paths without supervisor prompting.
15% faster. A veteran hauler — rarely idle, rarely inefficient.
20% faster. The colony's most reliable mover. Other dwarves clear the corridor when they hear them coming.
25% faster. A legendary porter whose efficiency borders on the supernatural. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:miner.description: Breaks stone, carves tunnels, and expands the colony's underground domain. The colony's primary engine of growth.

experience_levels.description: Can mine any solid block. Competent but unhurried.
5% faster. Learns to read rock grain — fewer wasted swings.
10% faster. Can reliably spot ore-bearing stone before it is fully exposed.
15% faster. Deep tunnels feel like home. Navigates collapse-risk zones with confidence.
20% faster. The mountain yields to a master miner. Other dwarves follow their tunnels because they're always the best way through.
25% faster. Small chance to find bonus ore or gem fragments when mining any vein. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:farmer.description: Plants, tends, and harvests all crops — both underground cave soil plots and surface dirt fields. Also responsible for tending beehives.

experience_levels.description: Can plant and harvest all crop types. Basic yields — nothing goes to waste, nothing exceptional either.
5% faster at all farm tasks. Harvest yield chance improves marginally — fewer empty plots.
10% faster. Reliable yields across all crop types. Can manage beehives without disturbing the colony.
15% faster. Harvest yields improve noticeably. Seasonal crop timing is handled with precision.
20% faster. Maximum yields from every plot. A master farmer turns a modest field into a colony-sustaining operation.
25% faster. Occasional double-yield harvests. Plants seem to grow faster when this dwarf is nearby. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:brewer.description: Operates the brewery and aging cellar. Unlocks increasingly complex recipes as experience grows. The colony's most craft-intensive profession.
__comment_recipe_gates: required_skill in recipe files maps directly to Brewer experience level.
A Brewer at level N can perform any recipe with required_skill ≤ N.
Level 1: required_skill 0–1 → Longbeard Ale, Mountain Cider, Pig Tail Cloth
Level 2: required_skill 0–2 → + Dark Stout, Sweet Mead
Level 3: required_skill 0–3 → + Grape Wine, Aged Dark Stout
Level 4: required_skill 0–4 → + Juniper Gin, Reserve Gin
Level 5: required_skill 0–5 → + Vintage Wine (full recipe roster unlocked)
Level 6: all recipes + 10% chance of bonus output unit per batch

experience_levels.description: Can brew basic ales and ciders (required_skill 0–1). Knows how to start a fire and not ruin the batch.
5% faster. Unlocks stouts and meads (required_skill 0–2). Starting to develop a palate.
10% faster. Unlocks grape wine and aged dark stout (required_skill 0–3). Understands that patience is an ingredient.
15% faster. Unlocks juniper gin and reserve gin (required_skill 0–4). The aging cellar holds no mysteries.
20% faster. Unlocks vintage wine (required_skill 0–5). Every recipe in the brewer's repertoire is available. Merchants notice.
25% faster. 10% chance of a bonus output unit on every completed batch. A legendary brewer whose drinks command premium prices. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:builder.description: Constructs walls, floors, and structures. Places and removes furniture. The colony's architect and interior designer.

experience_levels.description: Can place and remove all basic block types and furniture. Walls are straight. Mostly.
5% faster. Furniture placement is precise. Rooms come together with less wasted effort.
10% faster. Can read a floor plan and execute it without supervision.
15% faster. Structures are tight and well-proportioned. Other dwarves request this builder by name.
20% faster. A master builder. Their structures stand longer, seal better, and look finer than any other dwarf could manage.
25% faster. Buildings constructed by this dwarf gain a small structural integrity bonus. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:merchant.description: Staffs the Trade Counter in a Shop room. Manages buy orders, collects coins after trade, and represents the colony's commercial interests with visiting caravans.
__comment_sell_bonus: For Merchants, work_speed_bonus_per_level instead applies as a sale price modifier.
Each experience level above 1 adds +2% to all sale prices in the assigned shop.
At level 5: sale prices are +8% above base_trade_value (before demand modifiers).
At level 6: +10%. This stacks with the ±20% demand fluctuation on the merchant side.

experience_levels.description: Can staff a Trade Counter and process automated transactions. Gets the job done.
Sale prices +2%. Starting to read what caravans want before they arrive.
Sale prices +4%. Demand decay sets in more slowly — regulars get slightly better treatment.
Sale prices +6%. Caravans are slightly more likely to visit — word of a fair dealer spreads.
Sale prices +8%. The colony's trade reputation grows faster with a master merchant behind the counter.
Sale prices +10%. Attracts a rare caravan type unavailable to lesser merchants. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:innkeeper.description: Runs the Tavern room — serving drinks to visiting travelers and managing coin collection from guest room night stands. The colony's host.
__comment_bonuses: work_speed_bonus_per_level applies to drink service speed (SERVE_DRINK task duration).
Additionally, each level above 1 adds +1 gold coin to the flat guest lodging fee.
Base lodging fee: 5 coins. Level 5 Innkeeper: 9 coins per guest night.

experience_levels.description: Can serve drinks and collect lodging fees. Guests are served. Eventually.
5% faster service. +1 coin lodging fee. Learns which regulars want their ale before they sit down.
10% faster service. +2 coins lodging fee. Guests linger longer — a subtle mark of quality.
15% faster service. +3 coins lodging fee. Travelers recommend the inn to others. Spawn chance for new visitors ticks up.
20% faster service. +4 coins lodging fee. A master innkeeper. The tavern is always warm, the ale is always cold, and the beds are always made.
25% faster service. +5 coins lodging fee. Guests occasionally leave an extra tip on the night stand. Requires an exceptional trait.

base:profession:carpenter.description: Processes raw timber into furniture, structural components, and crafted wooden goods.
base:profession:carpenter.__comment: Requires a carpentry workshop and a full furniture/crafting design session before activation.

base:profession:blacksmith.description: Smelts raw ore into metal ingots and forges tools, weapons, and hardware.
base:profession:blacksmith.__comment: Requires a smelter and forge workshop design, plus metal ingot resources, before activation.

base:profession:weaponsmith.description: A promoted Blacksmith working exclusively at the Forge, crafting weapons and crossbows for the military.
base:profession:weaponsmith.__comment: Stub added 2026-08-07 (doc 22 close-out — DwarfFactory.PROFESSION_KEYS alignment). Restricted specialisation, doc 44: requires Blacksmith Level 3 (100 cumulative tasks) and an operational Forge; never assignable directly from Civilian. On promotion the experience count is set equal to the Blacksmith count (one-way carry-over, doc 44 §Experience Carry-Over). Activates with the Smelter & Forge milestone.

base:profession:armorsmith.description: A promoted Blacksmith working exclusively at the Forge, producing armour and shields for enlisted dwarves.
base:profession:armorsmith.__comment: Stub added 2026-08-07 (doc 22 close-out — DwarfFactory.PROFESSION_KEYS alignment). Restricted specialisation, doc 44: requires Blacksmith Level 3 (100 cumulative tasks) and an operational Forge; never assignable directly from Civilian. On promotion the experience count is set equal to the Blacksmith count (one-way carry-over, doc 44 §Experience Carry-Over). Activates with the Smelter & Forge milestone.
